title: ADEX common definitions
description: Shared primitive definitions for the ADEX public v1 contract.

ulid.description: Crockford base32 ULID, 26 characters, without prefix.

event_id.description: Opaque, client-generated event identifier. Deduplication key, unique per tenant.

subject_id.description: Anonymous, first-party, rotatable, tenant-scoped subject identifier. Never derived from device properties and never personally identifying.

correlation_id.description: Client- or server-supplied request correlation identifier, echoed on every response.

placement_key.description: Tenant-unique, human-authored name of a decision point, e.g. 'homepage.primary-cta'.

alternative_key.description: Tenant-unique key of one option that may be selected at a placement.

policy_key.description: Identifier of the selection strategy that produced a decision.

timestamp_utc.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. Only 'Z' is accepted; other offsets are rejected rather than converted.

context_value.description: A single context signal. Deliberately restricted to low-cardinality, non-identifying values.

context.description: Allow-listed, non-identifying signals describing the situation of a decision. Keys not declared in the tenant's placement configuration are rejected with 422.

eligible_alternative.description: One alternative the caller declares eligible for this decision.

policy_reference.description: The policy and configuration version that produced a decision.
